name: Biophagus
oracle_text: Genomic Enhancement — {T}: Add one mana of any color. If this mana is spent to cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
blocked_sentences: If this mana is spent to cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.

needs.what: a mana-ability rider (beside mana_grant / mana_uncounterable) that, when this ability's mana is spent to cast a spell of the given types, stages additional counters on that spell's object without using the stack -- e.g. "mana_grant": {"counters": {"+1/+1": 1}, "spell_types": ["Creature"]} writing GameObject.cast_enters_with at payment the way spell_enters_with_counters does at resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_grant accepts only 'keywords' and 'spell_types' (cards/loader/mana.py _mana_grant refuses any other key). mana_spent_trigger + the spell_enters_with_counters op would put a triggered ability on the stack ('When you spend this mana...', Jade Orb's wording), but this card prints 'If this mana is spent...' -- a static effect of the mana that uses no stack and cannot be responded to or Stifled, so the trigger is an approximation. The shipped templates for Animal Attendant and Jade Orb of Dragonkind silently drop this rider, so they are not a model.
